verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.restored: To children of Israel you shall say: Any man from children of Israel or from sojourners sojourning in Israel who gives from his seed to Molech shall surely be put to death; people of land shall stone him with stone.

familiar.text: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

verses.restored: I myself will set my face against that man and cut him off from midst of his people, because he gave from his seed to Molech, to make my sanctuary unclean and profane my holy name.

familiar.text: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

verses.restored: If hiding, people of land hide their eyes from that man when he gives from his seed to Molech, not putting him to death,

familiar.text: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:

verses.restored: then I will set my face against that man and against his clan, and cut him off and all who prostitute after him, prostituting after Molech, from midst of their people.

familiar.text: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.

verses.restored: The soul/life who turns to ghosts/mediums and familiar spirits, prostituting after them, I will set my face against that soul/life and cut him off from midst of his people.

familiar.text: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

verses.restored: Sanctify yourselves and be holy, for I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.

verses.restored: You shall keep my statutes and do them. I am YHWH who sanctifies you.

familiar.text: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.

verses.restored: Any man who curses his father or mother shall surely be put to death; his father or mother he cursed, his bloodguilt is on him.

familiar.text: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.

verses.restored: A man who commits adultery with wife of a man, who commits adultery with wife of his companion, adulterer and adulteress shall surely be put to death.

familiar.text: And the man that committeth adultery with another man’s wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

verses.restored: A man who lies with his father's wife has uncovered nakedness of his father; both shall surely be put to death; their bloodguilt is on them.

familiar.text: And the man that lieth with his father’s wife hath uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.restored: A man who lies with his daughter-in-law, both shall surely be put to death; confusion/violation they have done; their bloodguilt is on them.

familiar.text: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.restored: A man who lies with a male lyings of a woman, the two have done taboo/ritually abhorrent thing; they shall surely be put to death; their bloodguilt is on them.

familiar.text: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.restored: A man who takes a woman and her mother—it is wickedness; in fire they shall be burned, he and they, so there be no wickedness in your midst.

familiar.text: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

verses.restored: A man who gives his emission to a beast shall surely be put to death, and the beast you shall kill.

familiar.text: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

verses.restored: A woman who draws near to any beast to lie with it, you shall kill woman and beast; they shall surely be put to death; their bloodguilt is on them.

familiar.text: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.restored: A man who takes his sister, daughter of his father or daughter of his mother, and sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness, it is disgrace; they shall be cut off before eyes of children of their people. Nakedness of his sister he uncovered; he shall bear his iniquity.

familiar.text: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

verses.restored: A man who lies with woman in her menstruation/separation and uncovers her nakedness has laid bare her flow, and she has uncovered flow of her bloods; both shall be cut off from midst of their people.

familiar.text: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.restored: Nakedness of your mother's sister and father's sister you shall not uncover, for he has made naked his flesh; they shall bear their iniquity.

familiar.text: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister, nor of thy father’s sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

verses.restored: A man who lies with his aunt has uncovered nakedness of his uncle; their sin/misalignment they shall bear; childless they shall die.

familiar.text: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

verses.restored: A man who takes wife of his brother, it is impurity; nakedness of his brother he uncovered; childless they shall be.

familiar.text: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.

verses.restored: You shall keep all my statutes and all my judgments and do them, so land where I am bringing you to dwell does not vomit you out.

familiar.text: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.

verses.restored: You shall not walk in statutes of nation that I am sending from before you; for all these they did, and I was disgusted/grieved with them.

familiar.text: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

verses.restored: I said to you: You shall possess their ground, and I myself will give it to you to possess, a land flowing with milk and honey. I am YHWH your Divine, who separated you from peoples.

familiar.text: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.

verses.restored: You shall separate between clean beast and unclean, between unclean bird and clean; do not make your souls/lives detestable by beast or bird or anything that creeps on ground, which I separated for you as unclean.

familiar.text: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.

verses.restored: You shall be holy to me, for I, YHWH, am holy, and I separated you from peoples to be mine.

familiar.text: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

verses.restored: A man or woman in whom is ghost/medium or familiar spirit shall surely be put to death; with stones they shall stone them; their bloodguilt is on them.

familiar.text: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.

translation_notes: This chapter contains severe ancient penalty material and must be source-preserved with strong anti-violence safeguards.
Molech/child-sacrifice polemic is life-protection and sanctuary-name protection.

Leviticus 20:13 repeats the male-male boundary text with capital penalty in the ancient source; it requires deep lexical, historical, and reception-history audit and must not be used for modern violence, criminalization, bullying, or dehumanization of LGBTQ people.
Sexual-boundary penalties are embedded in land-holiness rhetoric and kinship system; do not flatten into modern identity categories.
Medium/familiar-spirit penalty material requires reception-history safeguards and must not be used against spiritual practitioners today.
